multivariate.description: Operator-authorized v1.2.0 amendment (ADR 0006): PERMANOVA/PERMDISP, packet R13, SM26-SM30.

post_de.description: Operator-authorized v1.3.0 amendment (ADR 0009): post-differential analysis, packets R14a-R14f, SM31-SM41 (contracts/post-de.md). Phase 4 only. Fields whose forbidden values have typed refusals (rule grammar, thresholds, permutation scope, null universe, imputation) are validated semantically, not by this schema.

compute_policy.description: D-59: adapt (default) scales repeats and permutations down to compute_guard_hours with a recorded adaptation; refuse is the opt-in strict mode (E_BIOMARKER_COMPUTE_GUARD).

classifier_params.description: Optional fixed tuning grids (A-2026-10-01-17): lambda for penalised logistic, cost for SVM; default grids are derived in-fold.

cut_height.description: Dendrogram cut height (A-2026-10-01-18): TOM dissimilarity for wgcna_signed (default 0.9), 1 - r for hclust_correlation (default 0.5).

allOf.description: Amendment ADR 0009 (A-2026-10-01-14): post-differential analysis is Phase 4 only; Phase 1-3 configurations cannot enable it.
